method: One separately recorded warm-up per case, then timed service calls including PNG. Stage times inclusive, not additive. First-observed call is not a cold-font guarantee. No HTTP or browser latency. Mr Bear uses current word-per-line Cake Topper behaviour. When comparison is enabled, alternate cached/uncached order each iteration; uncached calls use the original font paths via loaded=None, with the same current geometry and PNG renderer.
